subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr noticed the wraith was feasting, not hunting, and that this distinction mattered to his continued good health.
source_quote: The wraith was at the entrance to the Greater Temple when we arrived. Feasting. Not hunting. Feasting, which is a distinction that mattered to my continued good health.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr recalled the last time he stood close to the wraith and came away with something missing — not a wound, but a portion of himself the cold reached into and found worth keeping.
source_quote: The last time I'd stood this close to him, I'd come away with something missing: not a wound exactly, more like a portion of myself that the cold reached into and found worth keeping.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr appreciated Calmer's energy but had learned not to rely on it as a tactical plan.
source_quote: I appreciate the energy. I have learned not to rely on it as a tactical plan.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr realized the wraith was no longer performing menace but something closer to collegial warmth after being acknowledged and asked what it knew.
source_quote: I could feel the room tilt: the wraith no longer performing menace but something closer to collegial warmth. Peer to peer. I'd given it an audience.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr noticed the wraith had raised seven specters from bodies the party was responsible for killing.
source_quote: Seven specters. Raised from bodies we were responsible for.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr believed the wraith was building something and wanted to make sure it built it for them.
source_quote: Good, I thought. The wraith is building something. We need to make sure it builds it for us.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr asked the wraith who the Greater Temple was, and learned it was the deep temple — the people who are really in charge.
source_quote: The Greater Temple," the wraith said, "is the deep temple. It's the people who are really in charge.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr had been wrong about who sat at the top before — Romag, then Hartsch, then them — and now understood the ceiling kept rising.
source_quote: Every time I thought I'd found the ceiling, another one appeared above it.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr asked the voice behind the door how to meet the people in charge, and was told to survive the fight.
source_quote: Survive the fight, and maybe you'll get a chance.

subject: Zephyr's understanding of leadership
fact: Zephyr recognized that leadership in this war was being passed around like a burden no one wanted to hold.
source_quote: I thought: nobody in this room wants to hold the thing they're holding.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr noticed the wraith had become confident the outcome was already decided and was merely permitting time to catch up.
source_quote: He meant it warmly. The absolute confidence of something that has already decided the outcome and is merely permitting time to catch up.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia counted the soldiers and found their number wrong — fewer than expected for a faction holding its own ground.
source_quote: The number was wrong. Not collapse-of-the-faction wrong, but wrong enough that I counted them twice before I trusted what I was seeing.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia observed Hartsch was exhausted, dirty, and bloodied in ways that suggested proximity to the fighting, not command distance from it.
source_quote: He had been in it, or near enough.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia recognized the moment Hartsch stopped pretending to be in charge and asked them what to do next.
source_quote: Hartsch looked at us. 'What do we do next?' Four words. The authority transfer was complete.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia understood Hartsch had inherited a war he didn't fully understand and was losing forces he couldn't replace.
source_quote: Information he doesn't get to have. We built this; he inherited it.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia noticed Hartsch preferred to lose aggressively rather than win the way Romag had.
source_quote: Hartsch would rather lose aggressively than win the way that man had.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia observed Hartsch listing the temple strengths and weaknesses without pride, like reading damage he'd already accepted.
source_quote: He had listed it the way a man lists damage he's already accepted, in order, without argument, like reading something he already knew.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia knew Hartsch had sent the Broken Blades to attack without waiting for orders.
source_quote: I read it twice. Not because it was hard to read. Because I recognized it. 'I couldn't wait! I sent the Broken Blades to attack!'

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia recognized the phrase 'I couldn't wait' as a sentence he had lived inside of himself.
source_quote: 'I couldn't wait' is a sentence I have lived inside of.

subject: The Broken Blades
fact: The fate of the Broken Blades is unspecified after Hartsch sent them to attack without orders.
source_quote: I sent the Broken Blades to attack!

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia suspected Hartsch had left because he couldn't wait to act — and he knew he had done the same thing himself.
source_quote: I've decided, on my own, in the dark, that I knew better than the people standing next to me.

subject: The Romag room
fact: The significance of the Romag room — where the apostles slept — and its connection to legacy and authority is left unexplored.
source_quote: Zephyr wanted the Romag room. The dead man's quarters, the one place in this building nobody would think to bother us.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr noticed Hartsch handed the question of where the apostles slept off to him, and he handed deployment back to Hartsch.
source_quote: I watched Hartsch hand the whole question of where the apostles slept off to Zephyr, and Zephyr hand the question of deployment back to Hartsch.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia observed the war was running on its own momentum and didn't need them to keep burning.
source_quote: The war was running on its own momentum. Good. It didn't need us to keep burning.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia noticed the soldiers were watching the Obsidian Edge, waiting to see if they would disappear on them again.
source_quote: They were watching us, the Obsidian Edge, waiting to see if we were about to disappear on them again.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr recognized the wraith's laughter as a response to the door sealing them in — and understood the wraith was counting on their entrapment.
source_quote: He said 'my servants' with obvious satisfaction. He was counting on it.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr realized the wraith had been alone in the corridor for weeks, feasting on war leftovers, with nobody willing to call it by name or ask what it knew.
source_quote: It had been alone in this corridor for weeks, feasting on whatever the war left behind, with nobody willing to call it by name and ask it what it knew.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr noticed the wraith had stopped being a threat and become a conversational partner after being acknowledged.
source_quote: I'd given it an audience. The price of the audience was conversation, and conversation was exactly what I'd come for.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia recognized that Hartsch’s final order — 'We will make a final stand' — was a surrender to fatalism disguised as resolve.
source_quote: We will make a final stand. It's time we got it to Temple.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia knew Hartsch’s note — 'I couldn't wait!' — was a confession of the same impulse he himself had once acted on.
source_quote: I've decided, on my own, in the dark, that I knew better than the people standing next to me.

subject: The Greater Temple's true nature
fact: The identity of the 'people who are really in charge' in the Greater Temple remains unspecified.
source_quote: It's the people who are really in charge.

subject: The voice behind the door
fact: The identity of the voice behind the sealed Greater Temple door remains unknown.
source_quote: The Greater Temple is sealed until the battle is over. No one gets in, no one gets out.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr understood the wraith's promise — 'I can't wait till you come back here!' — was not a threat but a declaration of inevitability.
source_quote: He meant it warmly. The absolute confidence of something that has already decided the outcome and is merely permitting time to catch up.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia noticed the leadership vacuum in the Earth Temple had become so acute that Hartsch was asking them — the architects of the war — what to do next.
source_quote: Hartsch looked at us. 'What do we do next?' Four words. The authority transfer was complete.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr noticed the wraith’s specters were mostly Earth Temple forces — the very ones they had helped kill.
source_quote: I recognized the remnants of robes, the insignia, the general silhouette of people we had, in one way or another, contributed to killing.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr realized the wraith had become a repository of information and memory from the war — the only one willing to talk.
source_quote: Information was information, and the wraith was currently the only entity in the room willing to talk.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia observed the soldiers had stopped looking to Hartsch and were instead looking to each other.
source_quote: I could see it register: the soldiers' eyes going to each other instead of to him.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr noticed the wraith had stopped being a monster and become a mirror — reflecting back the consequences of their own actions.
source_quote: He counted them out. One, two, three. Four, five. Mostly Earth Temple forces. I recognized the remnants of robes, the insignia, the general silhouette of people we had, in one way or another, contributed to killing.

subject: Hartsch
fact: Hartsch was the version of me with no eye for consequence and no patience and a war to play with.
source_quote: Hartsch was the version of me with no eye for consequence and no patience and a war to play with.

subject: Hartsch
fact: Hartsch confessed it in pieces: he'd sent the Blades down to stage a raid on the Water Temple, and heard nothing back.
source_quote: Hartsch confessed it in pieces: he'd sent the Blades down to stage a raid on the Water Temple, and heard nothing back.

subject: Hartsch
fact: Hartsch had told them the orders came from us.
source_quote: He'd told them the orders came from us.

subject: Hartsch's loyalty
fact: Hartsch is our nominal superior and he's a liability and the day is coming when those two facts resolve.
source_quote: He'll be dealt with. That wasn't reassurance for them. It was a note to myself, the kind you don't say out loud because saying it spends it. He's our nominal superior and he's a liability and the day is coming when those two facts resolve.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr slapped him. Walked up and slapped the panic right across his face.
source_quote: Zephyr slapped him. Walked up and slapped the panic right across his face.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr gave up Water Temple dead in exchange for passage.
source_quote: Zephyr gave up Water Temple dead in exchange for passage.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia looked at the map where he'd marked his glorious initiative, and looked at him, and got the rest of it.
source_quote: Then Zinnia looked at the map where he'd marked his glorious initiative, and looked at him, and got the rest of it.

subject: Zinnia
fact: I stepped in front of them. Gore-soaked, hollow-eyed, finished men. I'd showed up. That mattered more than anything I could say.
source_quote: I stepped in front of them. Gore-soaked, hollow-eyed, finished men. I'd showed up. That mattered more than anything I could say.

subject: Zinnia
fact: I said the true thing: 'I don't know what your plans are. But whatever your plans are, you are with us. We are with you.'
source_quote: I said the true thing. 'I don't know what your plans are. But whatever your plans are, you are with us. We are with you.'

subject: Zinnia
fact: The men straightened. They looked at me and gave it back, the same words, a pledge: 'whatever your plans are, you are with us. We are with you.'
source_quote: The men straightened. They looked at me and gave it back, the same words, a pledge: 'whatever your plans are, you are with us. We are with you.'

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is a warrior of St. Cuthbert and we do not run from the dead.
source_quote: I am a warrior of St. Cuthbert and we do not run from the dead.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer called the rite of turning, the call that breaks the dead. The third time.
source_quote: I called it. The light went out of me in a single blast of judgment, and the room of dead things flinched as one.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer felt the floor of himself drop out and knew, instantly and completely, that he was at the very bottom of what a man can hold and still stand.
source_quote: I felt the floor of myself drop out and knew, instantly and completely, that I was at the very bottom of what a man can hold and still stand.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer did not heal. I did not run.
source_quote: I did not heal. I did not run.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer said, 'It worked! It worked!'
source_quote: 'It worked! It worked!' The words came out of me without permission, without dignity

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer said, 'Who's the man? Who is the man?'
source_quote: 'Who's the man? Who is the man?'

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer was at the very bottom of himself, one touch from gone, and I knew it. I want that recorded too.
source_quote: I was at the very bottom of myself, one touch from gone, and I knew it. I want that recorded too.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia said, 'One does not simply take bribes to defect.'
source_quote: 'One does not simply take bribes to defect.'

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia killed the bugbear with one clean cut.
source_quote: The first cut found exactly where it needed to go. Clean. He never even turned. It took most of him in the one exchange.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia turned a coin in the light because something was bugging me about the weight of it. The stamp wasn't Kelno's. Wasn't water at all. Air Temple insignia.
source_quote: I turned a coin in the light because something was bugging me about the weight of it. The stamp wasn't Kelno's. Wasn't water at all. Air Temple insignia, pressed clean into every piece.

subject: The true architect of the betrayal
fact: Kelno hadn't bought him. Somebody upstairs had let us believe Kelno was the one pulling at our bugbears, and the real hand was a different one entirely.
source_quote: Kelno hadn't bought him. Somebody upstairs had let us believe Kelno was the one pulling at our bugbears, and the real hand was a different one entirely.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr said, 'I don't have time for this one,' to the wraith.
source_quote: 'I don't have time for this one,' he told it.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr said, 'That's you,' to Calmer after the rite succeeded.
source_quote: 'That's you,' Zephyr said.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr told the Blades, 'Come backwards, we'll hold the line for now.'
source_quote: 'Come backwards, we'll hold the line for now.'

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr said, 'Alright, we'll deal with this, Dren.'
source_quote: 'Alright, we'll deal with this, Dren,' Zephyr said.

subject: Dren Halveth
fact: Dren Halveth said, 'You didn't say it would be a slaughterhouse!'
source_quote: 'You didn't say it would be a slaughterhouse!'

subject: Dren Halveth
fact: Dren Halveth said, 'Romag's replacement, Hartsch is a mad man! We're being fed to a meat grinder.'
source_quote: 'Romag's replacement, Hartsch is a mad man! We're being fed to a meat grinder.'

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia finished the last surviving specter: missed the first strike, took it on the second, and when it still refused, still clinging to the last of itself, he flowed into another and it was simply over.
source_quote: Zinnia finished it before it could try again.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia marked the wraith's knowledge: 'It remembers we came past. It remembers we paid in someone else's people.'
source_quote: I noted what it now knew about us. ... It remembers we came past. It remembers we paid in someone else's people.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia doesn't rally people. I observe, I wait, I move.
source_quote: I don't rally people. I observe, I wait, I move.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer said, 'Don't mess with me, man! I just killed the Wraith!'
source_quote: 'Don't mess with me, man! I just killed the Wraith!'

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer said, 'This is how the earth temple rules, with power and force!'
source_quote: 'This is how the earth temple rules, with power and force!'

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr said, 'Water temple,' to the wraith, without hesitation.
source_quote: 'Water temple,' Zephyr said. No hesitation.

subject: The Wraith
fact: The Wraith said, 'Oh, you're back!'
source_quote: 'Oh, you're back!'

subject: The Wraith
fact: The Wraith said, 'What do I get in exchange?'
source_quote: 'What do I get in exchange?'

subject: The Wraith
fact: The Wraith said, 'I was hoping for some Earth Temple blood.'
source_quote: 'I was hoping for some Earth Temple blood.'

subject: The Wraith
fact: The Wraith smiled, and it let us pass, and I watched it calculate the whole way through.
source_quote: It smiled, and it let us pass, and I watched it calculate the whole way through.

subject: Dren Halveth
fact: Dren Halveth asked, 'Do you need our help, boss?'
source_quote: 'Do you need our help, boss?'

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer said, 'I don't need any help to deal with the undead,' quieter, the hint pitched at us and not at them.
source_quote: 'I don't need any help to deal with the undead,' quieter, the hint pitched at us and not at them.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr said, 'Let's go.'
source_quote: 'Alright, calm,' Zephyr said. 'Let's go.'

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr said, 'Okay, so we'll go straight to the Broken Blades.'
source_quote: 'Okay, so we'll go straight to the Broken Blades,' Zephyr said.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr said, 'Remember who's the most powerful temple, bugbear?'
source_quote: 'Okay. Remember who's the most powerful temple, bugbear?'

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr said, 'We're gonna go kill him, Ben.'
source_quote: 'Uh, we're gonna go kill him, Ben.'

subject: The Bugbear
fact: The bugbear was babbling: 'Kelno had promised him safety. Kelno had promised him gold.'
source_quote: Babbling. Kelno had promised him safety. Kelno had promised him gold.

subject: The Gnolls
fact: The gnolls came out of the wall, talking about money: 'We paid good money for that! Now we will get our money, and get food!'
source_quote: 'We paid good money for that! Now we will get our money, and get food!'

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia said, 'I think he's okay.'
source_quote: 'I think he's okay.'

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia stood over the body and said, 'One does not simply take bribes to defect.'
source_quote: I stood over the body. 'One does not simply take bribes to defect.'

subject: Kelno
fact: Kelno had been recruiting, busily, badly, reaching over the Earth Temple's wall and peeling people off one frightened bugbear at a time.
source_quote: Kelno had been recruiting, busily, badly, reaching over the Earth Temple's wall and peeling people off one frightened bugbear at a time.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia has been getting funnier the deeper into this place we go.
source_quote: He has been getting funnier the deeper into this place we go.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer could not patch himself past the thin margin he was running on.
source_quote: he could not patch himself past the thin margin he was running on.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer was an over-eager zealot who resented being denied a fight he had no business standing in.
source_quote: Bellowed, full-throated, the over-eager zealot's outrage at being denied a fight he had no business standing in.

subject: Narrator
fact: The narrator knew that at three hit points the cleric was a resource they couldn't use.
source_quote: At three hit points the cleric was a resource I couldn't use;

subject: Narrator
fact: The narrator understood the whole situation before the second sentence arrived.
source_quote: and I understood the whole situation before the second sentence arrived.

subject: Narrator
fact: The narrator believed the gnolls' attack was a repeat of the same threat they'd faced before.
source_quote: The world charging me for existing again, except this one wanted to do it with its teeth.

subject: Narrator
fact: The narrator never flinches when confronted with threats based on their appearance.
source_quote: I didn't flinch. I never do, not for this.

subject: Narrator
fact: The narrator believed the dagger strike from concealment is the only blow that matters.
source_quote: The strike from concealment is the only blow that matters.

subject: Calmer's absence
fact: The narrator knows they need Calmer out front for whatever is behind the door, but cannot afford to wait for him.
source_quote: We needed him out front for whatever was in there. He absorbs what the rest of us can't afford to absorb. Without him that job doesn't get done.

subject: Narrator
fact: The narrator decided the next move was a recon mission, not an assault.
source_quote: Recon mission.
